contradictory_evidence: WHO verification can confirm that an attack on health care met its incident methodology while leaving perpetrator attribution or military circumstances unverified.
Conflict parties can offer incompatible accounts of military use, warning, weapon, origin and casualties; repetition by aligned media is not an independent cross-check.
Facility status changes quickly: a hospital described as non-functional on one cutoff date can partly reopen, while a nominally functional site may lack fuel, staff or supplies.
Legal protection is strong but application to a specific strike depends on facts; a general ICRC explainer cannot decide an individual allegation.
uncertainty: Current-event uncertainty is high and explicit. Browser search returned an authorization error and direct HTTPS retrieval hit a blocked proxy on 2026-09-02. HOLD all September 2026 incident and negotiation claims. A publishable update requires WHO or OCHA with cutoff, statements from relevant Israeli and Palestinian actors, and Reuters/AP/AFP or a documented open-source investigation.
